text:
casey: Hey — we're seeing a cluster of 502/503s from ingest at 03:10 but nobody got paged. Can someone oncall confirm? :eyes:

incident-bot: Alert aggregator received 4 alerts for service=ingest within 30s, applying suppression policy 'duplicate-window' (window=60s). Pages suppressed: 4.

sam: I saw the same in Grafana. Alerts escalated to #incidents but PD didn't page. I tried the PD web UI and the incident list is empty.

maria: Oncall here (handed off at 03:00). I didn't get a page. Did PD integration show errors?

kevin: Checking pd-bot logs now. `kubectl logs -n infra -l app=pagerduty-integration --tail=200` shows a 409 on create_event for a few events, looks like conflict/correlation key. Paste log snippet:```
2026-03-15T03:11:16Z WARN pd-integration: create_event failed status=409 body={"error":"Event already triggered","status":"conflict"} correlation_key=ingest-2026-03-15T03:11
2026-03-15T03:11:17Z INFO pd-integration: suppression check passed=true rule=duplicate-window window=60s matched=4
```

casey: So the bot both suppressed pages and then returned conflict when trying to create events. That combination meant no manual escalation happened. Is the conflict from PD dedup keys matching older incidents?

pd-bot: PagerDuty API returned 409 when creating event. Dedup key used: `ingest:ingress-502:us-west-2`. Suggested action: use change_key=true or generate unique dedup keys per alert.

sam: Immediate mitigation: I'll manually trigger an incident from PD and page the oncall. Maria, can you confirm the impacted customers list so we can assess scope?

maria: Quick check via support dashboard shows about 12 customers had error spikes between 03:09-03:12. Most requests retried ok, but two had persistent failures >2min. I'll paste a short list to the #support-sync after this.

kevin: I toggled the integration to bypass duplicate suppression for the ingest service (temporary) and re-ran the failed payloads via a replay script:```bash
# rerun events with unique keys
cat failed-events.json | jq -c '.[] | .dedup_key = (.dedup_key + "-retry-" + (now|tostring))' | while read ev; do curl -X POST -H "Content-Type: application/json" -H "Authorization: Token token=REDACTED" https://events.pagerduty.com/v2/enqueue -d "$ev"; done
```

incident-bot: Manual events accepted. 2 manual pages sent to oncall. Pages acknowledged by maria at 03:18. :thumbsup:

casey: Good. Can someone capture timeline + root cause for customers? Also we need a runbook step for when suppression+409 happen together.

maria: I started a quick timeline: alert first spike 03:10:52, alert group suppressed 03:11:16, pd create_event returned 409 03:11:17, retries stopped at 03:11:45 due to dedup logic. Manual page 03:18. I'll add details to the incident doc.

kevin: Root cause hypothesis: our event dedup key generation used only service+error-type+region which caused collisions with a prior stale dedup record in PD; the aggregator suppression policy also suppressed subsequent distinct alerts because they were within the duplicate window. Combined effect prevented a fresh page.

sam: Short-term remediation items (actions):
- disable suppress-on-group for ingest service (kevin) — DONE (03:22)
- replay failed events with unique dedup keys (kevin) — DONE (03:24)
- manual page & ack (maria) — DONE (03:18)

casey: Long-term fixes:
- change dedup key schema to include monotonic counter or timestamp (engineering, kevin)
- update suppression policy to consider 'severity' and 'distinct source' (product+eng)
- add a watchdog that escalates to a secondary channel if PD returns repeated 409s for >30s (oncall infra)

maria: I'll update the incident postmortem with customer impact and notify CS for outreach.

kevin: I'll open a PR to change the dedup key (proto and integration lib) + add unit tests. Plan to ship a patch release to infra namespace by tomorrow EOD. I'll include a migration note for existing stale dedup keys.

deploy-bot: New deployment queued: infra/pd-integration v1.12.3 -> running canary.

casey: Assign owners: kevin (integration fix), maria (postmortem + customer comms), sam (runbook updates), casey (follow up with PD support if we see more 409s).

pd-bot: If you need PD support escalation, open a support ticket with the API request ids and timestamps; include dedup keys.

sam: Runbook updates: add step to manually trigger PD incident (curl example) and to toggle suppression policy in PD:```bash
# quick manual page example
curl -X POST "https://api.pagerduty.com/incidents" -H "Authorization: Token token=REDACTED" -H "Content-Type: application/json" -d '{"incident": {"type":"incident","title":"Manual page - ingest 5xx spike","service": {"id":"PXXXX","type":"service_reference"}}}'
```

casey: Thanks all. I'll keep this thread for the follow-ups. Postmortem draft expected by EOD tomorrow. :memo: If anything else pops up, ping here or DM oncall.

maria: Noting customer list and next steps. Will sync with CS in 15. :phone:

kevin: Monitoring now, no new suppression events in last 30m. Will push integration fix PR this afternoon.

sam: Added a short-term playbook entry under infra/runbooks/pd-issues.md and linked the manual curl examples.

casey: Closing active paging problem — still tracking fixes. Thanks everyone. :pray:
